title: Prediction of Early Visual Outcome of Small-Incision Lenticule Extraction (SMILE) Based on Deep Learning.
summary: ResNet50 and XGBoost models predicted early visual recovery from SMILE surgical videos, with prospective cohorts used for testing. The article reports 318 eyes but inconsistent patient totals (159 in the abstract versus 164 across results cohorts), and the eye-level split may leave paired-eye dependence.
ai_technology: ResNet50 classifies scanning images from SMILE surgical videos; PCA-compressed image probabilities feed an XGBoost video-level visual-recovery classifier; Grad-CAM shows image regions.
